Class TransactionItemDTO

java.lang.Object
com.konbini.dto.TransactionItemDTO
public class TransactionItemDTO extends Object
Data Transfer Object (DTO) for representing individual items within a transaction. Used to transfer item-level transaction data between layers without exposing the domain model. Contains product details, quantity, and pricing information for each transaction item.
